passages.snippet: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”
Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.
She said, “Let it be as you have said.” She sent them away, and they departed. Then she tied the scarlet line in the window.
